scriptUiText: An assault frame on a burning aquifer. One sortie. Bring the ridge home, and Quill if you can.

Power always sums to 100. Nothing is allowed to hit zero.
Armor creeps back by spending the repair reservoir. Foam spends it faster and can reach Quill.
Rails punch shields. EMP strips them. The saber only works inside arm's reach.
